#pooled data CEs

##load data
```{r}
full.sdt=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/full_SDT_outlierremoved.csv"))[,-1]
full.sdt <- full.sdt %>%
  dplyr::select("Participant","dprime","c","condition")
names(full.sdt)[1]="subjectID"

full.cea=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/full_CEA_outlierremoved.csv"))[,-1]

full.acc=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/full_acc_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]
names(full.acc)[1]="subjectID"
cond=full.cea %>% dplyr::select(subjectID,condition)
full.acc=left_join(full.acc,cond)

full.optdev=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/full_optdev_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]

all.mlu=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/mlu_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]
all.steu=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/steu_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]
all.steu=all.steu %>% dplyr::select(subjectID,condition,STEU_score,STEU_sub_score,STEU_untrained)
all.emo.verb=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/emo_verb_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]



```

```{r}
all=full_join(full.cea,full.acc,by=c("subjectID","condition"))
all=full_join(all,full.sdt,by=c("subjectID","condition"))
all=full_join(all,full.optdev,by=c("subjectID","condition"))
all=full_join(all,all.steu,by=c("subjectID","condition"))
all=full_join(all,all.emo.verb,by=c("subjectID","condition"))
all=full_join(all,all.mlu,by=c("subjectID","condition"))

```

```{r}
# outlier summary
full.sub=all %>% dplyr::select(subjectID, condition,CEA_ave,dprime,c,ave.c.devi,accuracy, SegNum_ave,MLU_ave)
with_NA <- full.sub[!complete.cases(full.sub), ] #8 participant
num_NA <- sum(is.na(with_NA)) #12 datapoints

check=with_NA %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(total=n())

outlier_summary <- with_NA %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(-c(subjectID), ~ sum(is.na(.x)), .names = "{.col}")) %>%
  ungroup()

full.sub.1=all %>% dplyr::select(subjectID, condition,STEU_score,STEU_sub_score,STEU_untrained,total_unique_word,total_word)
with_NA <- full.sub.1[!complete.cases(full.sub.1), ] 
num_NA <- sum(is.na(with_NA)) 

check=with_NA %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(total=n())



```

# ANOVA - group difference in emo seg

```{r,echo=FALSE}
FULL=all

FULL$condition <- factor(FULL$condition, levels = c("NoLabel", "WithLabel", "Counting"))
FULL$color_order <- factor(FULL$condition, levels = c("NoLabel", "Counting", "WithLabel"))

```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
shapiro.test(FULL$dprime)#normal
```


```{r,echo=FALSE}
#test assumptions
leveneTest(dprime~condition,data=FULL) #no equal variance for dprime
leveneTest(c~condition,data=FULL) #equal variance for c
```

## mlu
main effect of condition in mlu
```{r,echo=FALSE}
fit6=aov(MLU_ave~condition,data=FULL)

```

### pairwise comparison

```{r}

```

### effect size
```{r}

```

#visual
```{r}

make_boxplot <- function(
    data,
    variable,
    title,
    comparisons = NULL,
    annotations = NULL
) {
  
  p <- data %>%
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = condition,
        y = .data[[variable]]
      )
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = color_order)) +
    scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(
      color = "black",
      size = 0.4,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)
    ) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    xlab("")
  
  if (!is.null(comparisons)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_signif(
        comparisons = comparisons,
        annotations = annotations,
        map_signif_level = FALSE,
        step_increase = 0.10,
        margin_top = 0.05,
        tip_length = 0.01,
        textsize = 5
      )
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```


```{r}

# Accuracy
p_accuracy <- make_boxplot(
  FULL, "accuracy", "Accuracy by condition",
  comparisons = list(
    c("NoLabel", "WithLabel"),
    c("WithLabel", "Counting"),
    c("NoLabel", "Counting")
  ),
  annotations = c("*", "***", "*")
)


# Sensitivity
p_sensitivity <- make_boxplot(
  FULL, "dprime", "Sensitivity by condition",
  comparisons = list(
    c("NoLabel", "WithLabel"),
    c("WithLabel", "Counting")
  ),
  annotations = c("**", "***")
)


# response bias
p_rb <- make_boxplot(
  FULL, "c", "Response bias by condition",
  comparisons = list(
    c("NoLabel", "WithLabel"),
    c("NoLabel", "Counting")
  ),
  annotations = c("***", "***")
)


# Consensus Event Agreement
p_CEA <- make_boxplot(
  FULL, "CEA_ave", "Consensus Event Agreement by condition",
  comparisons = list(
    c("NoLabel", "WithLabel"),
    c("WithLabel", "Counting"),
    c("NoLabel", "Counting")
  ),
  annotations = c("***", "***", "**")
)


# Segmentation number
p_segnum <- make_boxplot(
  FULL, "SegNum_ave", "Segmentation Number by condition",
  comparisons = list(
    c("NoLabel", "WithLabel"),
    c("NoLabel", "Counting")
  ),
  annotations = c("***", "***")
)


# Mean length unit
p_MLU <- make_boxplot(
  FULL, "MLU_ave", "Mean Length Unit by condition",
  comparisons = list(
    c("NoLabel", "WithLabel"),
    c("NoLabel", "Counting")
  ),
  annotations = c("***", "***")
)


# STEU total score
p_STEU <- make_boxplot(
  FULL, "STEU_score", "STEU Score by condition",
  comparisons = list(
    c("NoLabel", "WithLabel")
  ),
  annotations = "**"
)
```

```{r}
p_STEU_sub <- make_boxplot(
  FULL,
  variable = "STEU_sub_score",
  title = "STEU Subscore by condition"
)

p_STEU_untrained <- make_boxplot(
  FULL,
  variable = "STEU_untrained",
  title = "STEU Untrained Score by condition"
)

p_total_word <- make_boxplot(
  FULL,
  variable = "total_word",
  title = "Total Words by condition"
)

p_unique_word <- make_boxplot(
  FULL,
  variable = "total_unique_word",
  title = "Total Unique Words by condition"
)
```

```{r}
# 1. sdt
p_performance <- p_sensitivity + p_rb

ggsave(
  filename = "visual/sensitivity_rb.pdf",
  plot = p_performance,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)


# 2. acc + Consensus Event Agreement

p_accCEA <- p_accuracy + p_CEA
ggsave(
  filename = "visual/acc_CEA_boxplot.pdf",
  plot = p_accCEA,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)


# 3. Segmentation number and mean length unit
p_segmentation <- p_segnum + p_MLU

ggsave(
  filename = "visual/segnum_MLU.pdf",
  plot = p_segmentation,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)


# 4. STEU measures
p_STEU_group <- p_STEU + p_STEU_sub + p_STEU_untrained

ggsave(
  filename = "visual/STEU_measures.pdf",
  plot = p_STEU_group,
  width = 15,
  height = 5
)


# 5. Word-use measures
p_word_group <- p_total_word + p_unique_word

ggsave(
  filename = "visual/word_measures.pdf",
  plot = p_word_group,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)
```

##Whether STEU-emoseg link vary across conditions?
###CEA
```{r,echo=FALSE}
model=lm(CEA_ave~STEU_score*condition,data=all) #
summary(model)
```


```{r}
sim_slopes(
  model,
  STEU_score,
  condition,
  modx.values = NULL,
  centered = "all",
  cond.int = TRUE,
  confint=TRUE
)
```

  group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(total=n())

  group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(-c(subjectID), ~ sum(is.na(.x)), .names = "{.col}")) %>%

# ANOVA - group difference in emo seg

```{r,echo=FALSE}
FULL=all

FULL$condition=as.factor(FULL$condition)
FULL$condition <- relevel(FULL$condition, ref = "NoLabel")
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
shapiro.test(FULL$dprime)#normal
shapiro.test(FULL$STEU_score)#not normal
```


```{r,echo=FALSE}
#test assumptions
leveneTest(dprime~condition,data=all) #equal variance for dprime
leveneTest(c~condition,data=all) #equal variance for c
```

## CEA
```{r,echo=FALSE}
fit3=aov(CEA_ave~condition,data=all)
summary(fit3) #no main effect of condition in CEA

tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(fit3)
print(tukey_result) 

```

## accuracy
main effect of condition in accuracy
```{r,echo=FALSE}

fit4=aov(accuracy~condition,data=all)
summary(fit4) 
```

### pairwise comparison
labeling lower than nolabel and counting, counting - no label no difference
```{r}
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(fit4)
print(tukey_result)
```

### effect size
```{r}
eta_squared(fit4) 
```

## dprime
main effect of condition in dprime
```{r,echo=FALSE}
fit1=aov(dprime~condition,data=all)
summary(fit1) #
```

### pairwise comparison
no labeling no difference in dprime with counting, both higher than with-label
```{r}
#pairwise:
options(es.use_symbols = TRUE) 
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(fit1)
print(tukey_result) #
```

### effect size
```{r}
eta_squared(fit1) #eta2 = 0.09
```


## c
no main effect of condition in c
```{r,echo=FALSE}

fit2=aov(c~condition,data=all)
summary(fit2) #
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(fit2)
print(tukey_result)
```

##deviation from optimal c
main effect of condition in deviation from optimal c
```{r,echo=FALSE}

fit5=aov(ave.c.devi~condition,data=all)
summary(fit5) #
```

### pairwise comparison
labeling group deviate less than nolabeling group and marginally lower than the counting group; no difference between counting and nolabel group
```{r}
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(fit5)
print(tukey_result)
```

### effect size
```{r}
eta_squared(fit5) #eta2 = 0.04
```
